# Revisions

What revisions of each type look like, where the current revision is held, and what a revise does to an object of the type. A derived type takes its bases' rules unless it says its own; "said by" names the type whose rule it is.

## Drawing

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `Drawing` |
| First revision | `A` |
| Separator | `.` |
| Held in | `revision` |

| Level | Name | Values | First | Skipped | Width | Starts empty | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `major` | letters | `A` | I, O, Q, S, X, Z |  | no | A, B, C, D, E |
| 2 | `minor` | numbers | `1` |  |  | yes | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 |

### When revised

| Lifecycle | Does | Said by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [DrawingLifecycle](processes/drawing-lifecycle.md) | goes to `InWork` | `Drawing` |

Every value is copied.

| Links through | Does | Said by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sheets` | each revision keeps a link of its own | `Drawing` |

What happens to links through other ends is the team's to decide.

## Specification

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `Specification` |
| First revision | `01` |
| Separator | `.` |
| Held in | the team's system |

| Level | Name | Values | First | Skipped | Width | Starts empty | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 |  | numbers | `01` |  | 2 | no | 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 |

### When revised

| Lifecycle | Does | Said by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Approval](processes/approval.md) | starts over | no rule: the default |
| [ReviewLifecycle](processes/review-lifecycle.md) | keeps its states | `Specification` |

| Attribute | Does | Said by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `approvedBy` | reset to its default, else empty | `Specification` |
| `reviewNote` | cleared | `Specification` |

Other values are copied.

What happens to its links is the team's to decide.

## Moves that revise

A revise move makes a new revision to work on, at its level (level 1 when it names none). A move with a level and another verb gives the object its next revision at that level and changes nothing else.

### [DrawingLifecycle](processes/drawing-lifecycle.md)

| Move | Trigger | From | To | Does | Level |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | event `release` | `Approved` | `Released` | gives the next revision | 1 |
| 3 | event `revise` | `Released` | `InWork` | makes a new revision | 2 |

### [ReviewLifecycle](processes/review-lifecycle.md)

| Move | Trigger | From | To | Does | Level |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | event `revise` | `Reviewed` | `Draft` | makes a new revision | 1 |
